About the author

Amir Ali is a remarkable Data Scientist, with an unwavering passion for delving into the captivating realms of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Natural Language Processing. He has achieved a milestone by successfully completing his Master's Degree in Data Science at the prestigious Warsaw University of Technology, where he had the honor of being fully funded throughout his academic journey. Amir's academic brilliance extends to his Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, which he earned from the renowned University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore. His dedication to the field of data science knows no bounds, as he continues to explore and unravel the mysteries concealed within the vast sea of data.
